objectives_fil: Sa halimbawang BHS, itala ang tatlong pag-aaksaya, ang ebidensya at isang ligtas na routine na makababawas sa paghahanap o dobleng pag-order.
objectives_en: In a sample BHS, record three sources of waste, their evidence and a safe routine that reduces searching or duplicate ordering.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tukuyin muna ang nasasayang na resources bago pumili ng pagtitipid.
sections.takeaway_en: Identify wasted resources before choosing a saving measure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang maayos na imbakan ay tumutulong sa ligtas na paggamit at tumpak na paghingi ng resources.
sections.takeaway_en: Orderly storage supports safe use and accurate resource requests.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang kaayusan ay pinananatili ng simpleng routine at pananagutan.
sections.takeaway_en: A simple routine and clear responsibility sustain order.

sections.takeaway_fil: Magsimula sa nakitang pag-aaksaya at maayos na routine, hindi sa hula na kulang ang budget.
sections.takeaway_en: Start with observed waste and a reliable routine, not an assumption that the budget is insufficient.

sections.takeaway_fil: Magsimula sa nakitang pag-aaksaya at maayos na routine, hindi sa hula na kulang ang budget.
sections.takeaway_en: Start with observed waste and a reliable routine, not an assumption that the budget is insufficient.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi makita ang handouts kaya may gustong mag-order ulit. Ano muna?
check.prompt_en: Handouts cannot be found, so someone wants to reorder. What first?

options.fil: Mag-order agad ng doble para sigurado.
Suriin ang labeled storage, approved version at bilang ng stock.
options.en: Check labeled storage, approved version and stock count.

options.fil: Gamitin ang anumang lumang handout na makita.
options.en: Use any old handout that can be found.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikalawang sagot ay sinusuri ang tunay na pangangailangan at tamang materyal. Ang dobleng order ay maaaring pag-aaksaya; ang lumang handout ay maaaring maling bersyon.
check.feedback_en: The second response checks actual need and the correct material. Duplicate ordering may waste resources; an old handout may be the wrong version.
